D=.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1520/31349889147-1/diff.patch
for k in 1 2 3 4; do

  awk -v s=$s -v e=$e '/^diff --git/{n++} n>=s && n<=e' "$D" > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1520/31349889147-1/batch-$k.patch

done

awk '/^diff --git/{n++} n>=21 && n<=30' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1520/31349889147-1/diff.patch > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1520/31349889147-1/batch-3.patch
awk '/^diff --git/{n++} n>=31 && n<=40' .prflow/tmp/re …[per-command-truncated]
